subject: Discovery scheduling: split business + deep-dive for Stripeway
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@stripeway.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Delgado <marcus.delgado@stripeway.com>, procurement@stripeway.com
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — evaluating Redwood for inference serving

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick intro. We (Stripeway) are exploring inference platforms to standardize low-latency serving for our edge robotics team. I am the internal champion; Marcus (CC'd) is our engineering lead and will own the technical evaluation. Procurement is looped for timing and initial commercial questions.

High-level ask: can we schedule a discovery that covers a 30 min business-level overview with our product champion + AE, followed by a 60 min engineering deep-dive (SE + infra lead)? Prefer the two back-to-back on the same day if possible. That helps us keep calendars tight.

Our rough availability next week (PST):
- Tue 6/1: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 6/2: 09:00–11:30

Also: please share any security questionnaire and a draft SOW we can start feeding to procurement.

Thanks,
Lina

--
Lina Torres
Head of Product Partnerships, Stripeway
Lina.Torres@stripeway.com
+1 415-555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@stripeway.com>
Cc: Marcus Delgado <marcus.delgado@stripeway.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — evaluating Redwood for inference serving

Hi Lina — great to meet you over email and thanks for the clear ask. Happy to do the split session. Proposed format: 30 min "Champion + AE" overview (business goals, success metrics, high-level architecture), then a 60 min "SE + Eng" deep-dive covering latency SLOs, KV cache patterns, and deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

Suggested slots (all PST):
- Tue 6/1: 10:30–12:00 (30 + 60 back-to-back)
- Wed 6/2: 09:00–10:30 (if you prefer earlier)

I copied Soojin (SE) who can lead the deep-dive content. She also asked if Marcus can share any short pre-read (model sizes, expected QPS, seq lengths) — 1 paragraph is fine.

I attached a short intake checklist that helps our SE prep (redwood_demo_intake.pdf). We'll also attach a security questionnaire and a draft SOW in a follow-up to procurement.

If those slots work I'll send a calendar invite with separate meets but contiguous timing.

Best,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Marcus Delgado <marcus.delgado@stripeway.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lina Torres <lina.torres@stripeway.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — evaluating Redwood for inference serving

Ben — thanks for the options. Quick constraints on our side:
- Avoid 09:00–11:00 PST on Tue 6/1 (on-call rotation overlap)
- Wed 6/2 09:00 is OK but we prefer not to push past 11:00 PST due to sprint planning

If possible, Tue 6/1 15:00–16:30 PST would be ideal for us (we can do 30+60 in that window).

Pre-read: we're testing a 3B-7B model mix, peak burst QPS ~120, typical sequences 128–512. We're planning a mix of hosted and dedicated testbeds.

Marcus

--
Marcus Delgado
Senior Staff Engineer, Stripeway
marcus.delgado@stripeway.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Delgado <marcus.delgado@stripeway.com>, Lina Torres <lina.torres@stripeway.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@stripeway.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — evaluating Redwood for inference serving

Thanks Marcus — Tue 6/1 15:00–16:30 PST works. I'll book a 30 + 60 contiguous block.

Marissa (copied) is our commercial lead and will coordinate procurement questions and SOW draft delivery. Procurement team at Stripeway — we'll send an initial SOW draft and basic commercial terms; happy to take a short procurement-only sync if you'd like, but we can also route the SOW and redlines via DocuSign/HubSpot.

Action items before the deep-dive:
- Marcus: short pre-read (model sizes/QPS) — you provided that, thanks.
- Lina: confirm attendees for the 30-min champion session.
- Soojin: I'll ask you to prepare a short demo of KV caching and a live perf run if network permits.

Attaching SOW draft v1 now (SOW_draft_v1.pdf). Marissa — can you confirm procurement timeline?

Cheers,
Ben

Thanks for the SOW draft. A couple quick asks: can you provide a one-page pricing summary (list price + committed capacity discount tiers), and an editable SOW (docx) so our legal can track changes? Also we need the security questionnaire completed for our InfoSec review — attaching our template (will forward separately to security@redwoodinference.com if you prefer).

Target timeline: contract review within 10 business days of receiving an editable SOW + security questionnaire. If you can confirm we can align procurement follow-up during week of 6/14.

Procurement
Stripeway
